fixes.what: The 1278 gain of Butrint (confidence 3) names house-of-anjou-sicily as the loser and its note calls the allies 'the anti-Angevin coalition', but the page says Charles of Anjou was one of the allies and the Butrint page says the town was Byzantine from 1274 until the allies drove the Byzantines out in 1278.
fixes.why: Nikephoros I Komnenos Doukas page: 'The coalition of Charles of Anjou, Nikephoros, and the latter's half-brother John I Doukas of Thessaly ... gained several cities, including Butrinto in 1278'. Butrint page: 'In 1274, Byzantine forces re-entered Butrint' and 'the two allied against Byzantine Emperor Michael, and together drove the Byzantines from the area in 1278'. A confidence-3 note that misstates its page counts as fabricated under this run's rules.
